funnel_semantics.discovered: Raw fixtures returned by the fixture discovery call for the run.
funnel_semantics.eligible: Discovered fixtures that pass status, time-window, duplicate-block and league eligibility checks.
funnel_semantics.modelled: Eligible fixtures for which the model successfully produced probabilities and expected goals; odds availability is not required for this stage.
funnel_semantics.predictions: Market-level prediction records produced from successfully modelled fixtures.
funnel_semantics.candidates: Fixture-level candidates retained after at least one market passes the existing EV/edge/odds gates.
funnel_semantics.selections: Final bets appended by the existing allocation and BetStore selection path.

funnel_semantics.discovered: Raw fixtures returned by the fixture discovery call for the run.
funnel_semantics.eligible: Discovered fixtures that pass status, time-window and league eligibility checks.
funnel_semantics.modelled: Eligible fixtures for which the model successfully produced probabilities and expected goals.
funnel_semantics.predictions: Market-level prediction records produced from successfully modelled fixtures.
funnel_semantics.odds_available: Modelled fixtures for which the provider returned at least one valid market quote.
funnel_semantics.valid_quotes: Market-level quotes accepted by the quote normalizer and available for strategy evaluation.
funnel_semantics.candidates: Market-level candidates that pass all existing odds/EV/edge gates.
funnel_semantics.ev_pass: Market-level evaluations that pass the configured EV threshold.
funnel_semantics.edge_pass: Market-level candidates that pass the configured probability-edge threshold.
funnel_semantics.risk_checks: Candidates presented to the existing staking/risk allocator.
funnel_semantics.selected: Candidates selected by the existing allocator before persistence.
funnel_semantics.persisted_bets: Production bets successfully appended by the idempotent BetStore.
funnel_semantics.settled: Production bets that subsequently reach a terminal settlement state.
